      "type": "objection",

      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author decoupled version from CLIENT_VERSION and introduced feature flag records",

      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "c:3050272556",
      "status_by_quote": "I've updated the PR to do a combination of @maflcko's and @ryanofsky's suggestions."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2941109291",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Failed WriteLastDecryptedFeatures still updates the in-memory guard, preventing retry of the write on subsequent unlocks",

      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author explained automatic upgrades are no-ops if repeated, reviewer subsequently ACKed",

      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "r:4690084116",
      "status_by_quote": "I did not find additional issues. CI is green."

      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Using high bits and 1ULL for int32_t wastes 3/4ths of available version space",
      "quote": "seems something of a shame to waste 3/4ths of the available space",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "changed to MIN_VERSION = (1L << 19) and incrementing on that",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3149906809"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3149906809",
      "status_by_quote": "Changed `VERSION_MASK` to `MIN_VERSION = (1L << 19)`, and for the subsequent version number to increment on that."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3145159898",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Unclear extension and compatibility plan once more than 64 features are needed",
      "quote": "What happens when you want to implement a 65th wallet feature?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "explained extension flag approach and version bump criteria",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3149899553"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3149899553",
      "status_by_quote": "for the 64th feature, there are actually 2 flags, one flag to indicate that there are more feature flags, and then we extend the record"
    },

      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Missing cs_wallet locking annotations on SetLastDecryptedFeatures",
      "quote": "`GUARDED_BY(cs_wallet)` ? if so, `SetLastDecryptedFeatrues()` needs `EXCLUSIVE_LOCKS_REQUIRED`",

      "status_note": "author added locking annotations",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3156344543"],
      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "rc:3156344543",
      "status_by_quote": "Sure, done."

      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author explained it defines the lower bound of the enum and was written in introducing commit; Eunovo later ACKed",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author implemented suggestion to delete stale features record on loading older version",
      "author_replies": ["c:5705381423"],
      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "r:5229324703",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK 1f5c103fe079d7e42003b8b29c156d3fc9204053"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4045407272",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Whether last_client == VERSION_LATEST is always true at this point in LoadWallet",
      "quote": "Isn't this always true? `last_client = VERSION_LATEST` and `VERSION_LATEST = VERSION_LAST_CLIENT_FEATURES`",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained last_client is overwritten when reading DBKeys::VERSION",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4050144525"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4050144525",
      "status_by_quote": "No, `last_client` is overwritten by `m_batch->Read(DBKeys::VERSION, last_client)` if the record exists in the database."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4045452325",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Silently ignoring WriteLastDecryptedFeatures failure allows SetLastDecryptedFeatures to update in-memory state on error",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author marked nodiscard and guarded SetLastDecryptedFeatures",

      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "rc:4050530156",
      "status_by_quote": "Done"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4045470388",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added checks to fail migration on write error",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4050530987"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4050530987",
      "status_by_quote": "Done"
    },

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Use a single feature enum with partitioned MSB/LSB bits instead of separate enums for decrypted and encrypted features",

      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained that having two separate fields is easier",
      "author_replies": ["c:5735960525"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5735960525",
      "status_by_quote": "It's easier to have 2 fields."
    },

      "id": "rc:4143549747",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Consider returning LOAD_FAIL instead of CORRUPT on write failure when loading wallet",

      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained write failure during load is considered corruption",

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4147325067",
      "status_by_quote": "I consider write failures to be corruption failures, especially upon loading. A write failure means that something very bad is happening."
    }

participants.note: objected to coupling wallet client record to CLIENT_VERSION and reviewed nits
Concept ACK; suggested decoupling from CLIENT_VERSION and using feature flags
ACKed, suggested deleting stale decrypted features on reload after downgrade, reACKed
questioned unhandled write failures on unlock, later tested and ACKed

claims.text: Coupling to CLIENT_VERSION causes false upgrade or downgrade detection when switching between versions even if wallet code is identical
claims.quote: the coupling is confusing and makes testing harder
claims.status_note: author decoupled version from CLIENT_VERSION and introduced feature flag records
claims.status_by_quote: I've updated the PR to do a combination of @maflcko's and @ryanofsky's suggestions.

claims.text: Failed WriteLastDecryptedFeatures still updates the in-memory guard, preventing retry of the write on subsequent unlocks
claims.quote: If `WriteLastDecryptedFeatures()` fails, this still updates the in-memory guard, so the write won't be retried on subsequent unlocks.
claims.status_note: author explained that automatic upgrades are idempotent no-ops if repeated
claims.status_by_quote: It doesn't matter. The automatic upgrades are no-ops if they've already been done.

claims.text: Using high bits and 1ULL for int32_t wastes 3/4ths of available version space
claims.quote: seems something of a shame to waste 3/4ths of the available space
claims.status_note: changed to MIN_VERSION = (1L << 19) and incrementing on that
claims.status_by_quote: Changed `VERSION_MASK` to `MIN_VERSION = (1L << 19)`, and for the subsequent version number to increment on that.

claims.text: Unclear extension and compatibility plan once more than 64 features are needed
claims.quote: What happens when you want to implement a 65th wallet feature?
claims.status_note: author explained the extension plan using a continuation bit and uint64_t extension record
claims.status_by_quote: for the 64th feature, there are actually 2 flags, one flag to indicate that there are more feature flags, and then we extend the record with another `uint64_t`

claims.text: Missing cs_wallet locking annotations on SetLastDecryptedFeatures
Features are not initialized upon wallet creation
claims.quote: Should this also initalize the features?

claims.text: Make MIN_VERSION a separate const instead of an enum member since it is not an actual writable version
claims.quote: `MIN_VERSION` is not an actual writable version, so it's a bit misleading for it to be part of the enum; consider making it a separate `const`.
claims.status_note: author declined, stating MIN_VERSION marks the lower bound of the enum
claims.status_by_quote: It is written in the commit that introduces it. I don't think it makes sense to have it be separate, it's defining the lower bound of this enum

claims.text: Stale LAST_DECRYPTED_FEATURES remaining after a downgrade can restore old features on locked reload and prevent upgrades
claims.quote: Should we delete `LAST_DECRYPTED_FEATURES` when loading a wallet that was last opened by a client that doesn’t support this record?
claims.status_note: author implemented suggestion to delete stale features record on loading older version

claims.text: Whether last_client == VERSION_LATEST is always true at this point in LoadWallet
claims.quote: Isn't this always true? `last_client = VERSION_LATEST` and `VERSION_LATEST = VERSION_LAST_CLIENT_FEATURES`
claims.status_note: author explained last_client is overwritten when reading DBKeys::VERSION
claims.status_by_quote: No, `last_client` is overwritten by `m_batch->Read(DBKeys::VERSION, last_client)` if the record exists in the database.

claims.text: Silently ignoring WriteLastDecryptedFeatures failure allows SetLastDecryptedFeatures to update in-memory state on error
claims.quote: This is silently ignoring the returned value. Probably make the function [[nodiscard]] and only call `SetLastDecryptedFeatures` if there is no error?
claims.status_note: author marked nodiscard and guarded SetLastDecryptedFeatures

claims.text: Migration ignores return values of setting last opened and decrypted features instead of failing migration on write errors
claims.quote: This are all ignoring the returned values. Should fail migration if this fails?
claims.status_note: author added checks to fail migration on write error

claims.text: Use a single feature enum with partitioned MSB/LSB bits instead of separate enums for decrypted and encrypted features
claims.quote: I wonder if instead of two separate feature enums for decrypted and encrypted we could use the same and have half most significant bits for encrypted and the other half for the unencrypted.
claims.status_note: author explained that having two separate fields is easier

claims.text: Consider returning LOAD_FAIL instead of CORRUPT on write failure when loading wallet
claims.quote: I wonder if `CORRUPT` is the right error code here, maybe `LOAD_FAIL`?
claims.status_note: author explained write failure during load is considered corruption
claims.status_by_quote: I consider write failures to be corruption failures, especially upon loading. A write failure means that something very bad is happening.

claims.text: Avoid version numbers altogether and use feature flags written to LAST_OPENED_FEATURES and LAST_DECRYPTED_FEATURES
claims.quote: It would be nice to avoid version numbers altogether and use feature flags instead
claims.status_note: author incorporated feature flags alongside decoupled versioning
claims.status_by_quote: I've updated the PR to do a combination of @maflcko's and @ryanofsky's suggestions.

support.reason: It shouldn't hurt to add more metadata to help detect when there might be a mix of old data in a newer format and new data in an older format in the same wallet.
Except for lack of clarity on what happens after 64 features, this looks good to me.
The revised wallet-client version namespace, creation-time metadata initialization, and cs_wallet annotations address the intervening review feedback; I did not find additional issues. CI is green.
